bad.title: Named for when, not for what
bad.text: “Screenshot 2026-01-10” says when it was taken, nothing about the problem it shows.

bad.title: Search has nothing to match
bad.text: “empty” finds none of the 9 files, though three are empty states.

good.title: A tag names the problem
good.text: Tags like error and empty state are the words people search with later.

good.title: “empty” finds all three
good.text: Inbox, search and trips come up, so a past solution is one search away.

bad.title: “Nice list” keeps no reason
bad.text: It says the list is good, not what makes it work.

bad.title: Dark or Gray is a guess
bad.text: The price is new, and nothing in the note says how to treat it.

good.title: One line on why it works
good.text: “Only the title is dark” still applies to a column the copy never had.

good.title: The reason picks the color
good.text: A gray price keeps titles the only dark text, so the answer is Gray.

bad.title: Three perfect trips, the easy case
bad.text: Neat photos and short dates are the part that needed the least design.

bad.title: Nothing to learn for Empty
bad.text: When people have no trips yet, there’s no example of what to show them.

bad.title: 1 of 5 states studied
bad.text: The other four are where the hard decisions live.

good.title: The showcase is one of five
good.text: The same three trips, kept next to the states that took the work.

good.title: An error with a way out
good.text: “Your trips are safe” and Try again, worth copying and saved only because it was captured.

good.title: Even the keyboard path is saved
good.text: Tab order, the focus ring and what a screen reader says, captured in a minute.

bad.title: Two cards, four hidden differences
bad.text: Padding, weight, color and corners all differ, so the eye only gets a feeling.

bad.title: “Feels nicer” has no answer
bad.text: A feeling can’t be reused. People need a property they can name.

good.title: The same two cards
good.text: Only the question changed, and now the differences are easy to see.

good.title: One property per button
good.text: Each press points at a single thing to compare.

good.title: A difference with numbers
good.text: Title weight 700 on the left, 500 on the right. That goes straight into a design.

bad.title: Approved in week 1
bad.text: Sign-off came before anyone saw real names or real timing.

bad.title: Three short names, ready at once
bad.text: Desk lamp, Reading lamp, Floor lamp. The real names are a full line longer.

bad.title: Week 4: names cut, a blank second
bad.text: Long names are cut off, and nothing shows during the 1.2 s wait.
bad.wait: Open the first build and type “lamp” to see this.

good.title: Week 1, already in code
good.text: The risky search is built before sign-off, while the design can still change.

good.title: Searching… fills the 1.2 s
good.text: The real delay showed up in week 1, so the design got a loading line.

good.title: Long names wrap to two lines
good.text: The prototype used the real product names, so the layout was made for them.
good.wait: Type “lamp” and wait a moment to see this.

bad.title: A name like any other branch
bad.text: Nothing in search-suggestions tells reviewers the code is throwaway.

bad.title: A fake delay with no warning
bad.text: DELAY = 1200 and a hard-coded blue look like real choices to the next reader.

bad.title: The fake delay ships
bad.text: Months later, people wait 1.2 s for every suggestion, and nobody knows why.

good.title: The branch name starts with prototype/
good.text: Anyone scanning the branches sees what it is before opening it.

good.title: A warning at the top of the file
good.text: It names what’s fake and says to rebuild before shipping.

good.title: Rebuilt, not merged
good.text: A task replaces the prototype with tokens and tests. The fake delay never ships.

bad.title: A slider with no target
bad.text: Anything from 1 to 8 s could be right, so there’s nowhere to stop.

bad.title: Tweaks only count up
bad.text: After eight moves it still isn’t done. People stop when they’re tired.

good.title: The same slider, now with an end
good.text: Move it to 4 s and the check passes. That’s where to stop.

good.title: Done when, written first
good.text: A two-line caption takes about 4 s to read, so that’s the bar.

good.title: Each value gets a verdict
good.text: Under 4 s fails, 4 to 6 s passes, and past 6 s people wait too long.

bad.title: Only the tidy case was tried
bad.text: A short name, 24 songs, cover art and a wide screen.

bad.title: An empty playlist is a blank card
bad.text: No art and no songs, and no way to add any from here.

bad.title: Buttons cut off on a small phone
bad.text: Play, Shuffle and Share don’t fit, so Share is out of reach.

good.title: Each messy case, on purpose
good.text: Long name, Empty, Slow and Small phone, each tried before launch.

good.title: Empty gets an Add songs button
good.text: People get a next step instead of a hole.

good.title: Buttons wrap on a small phone
good.text: Play, Shuffle and Share drop to a second line instead of being cut.
good.wait: Press Small phone to see this.

bad.title: Mia asks a settled question
bad.text: The decision was made in March, but nothing on the issue says so.

bad.title: 214 messages, no answer
bad.text: The reason was only said on a call, so Mia books a meeting to ask again.
bad.wait: Press Find the reason to see this.

good.title: The decision, one click away
good.text: The issue links PR #377, right where Mia asks the question.

good.title: Why, and what was turned down
good.text: Album listeners said extra songs ruined the ending. Similar songs stay on for playlists.
good.wait: Press Find the reason to see this.

bad.title: Only the winner and its reason
bad.text: Tax included, and why. Nothing about what else was tried.

bad.title: The same idea, argued again
bad.text: Adding tax at checkout was already tested, and nobody remembers. A 45-minute meeting follows.
bad.wait: Press Ben’s proposal to see this.

good.title: The rejected option, with its result
good.text: Tax at checkout lost people at the last step, so nobody needs to try it again.

good.title: The record answers Ben
good.text: He reads the line on checkout and drops the idea. No meeting needed.
good.wait: Press Ben’s proposal to see this.

bad.title: Merged 3 weeks ago, still unwritten
bad.text: By now the trade-offs weighed in the review are mostly forgotten.

bad.title: “It seemed best” as the reason
bad.text: “Some were discussed” and a decision. Nobody can learn from that.
bad.wait: Press Write it up to see this.

good.title: A draft, open while choosing
good.text: Each option gets its trade-off while the reasons are still fresh.

good.title: Writing B’s trade-off finds C
good.text: Follow the system, with a switch to override it, closes the gap in B.
good.wait: Press Write the next trade-off twice to see this.

bad.title: Opens with a refactor
bad.text: SortService and an index are what reviewers read first, and they sound harmless.

bad.title: Approved as a refactor
bad.text: The new sort order, the change people will notice, sat on the last line.

good.title: Opens with what people will notice
good.text: Photos sort by the day they were taken. Reviewers know what to look at.

good.title: How it’s built comes last
good.text: The index and cache keys are still there for those who need them.

good.title: The reviewer checks old scans
good.text: Knowing the change, they test the case most likely to look wrong.
